propositions: Reconcile Bridge runs on GitHub Actions lack CloudWatch observability; bridge failures produce zero CloudWatch signal and are visible only to users inspecting the run directly
GitHub Actions OIDC credential flow must be configured in reconcile-bridge.yml to publish bridge_run_failures metric to CloudWatch namespace rebar/host with value 1 on failure and 0 on success

A new narrowly-scoped IAM role must grant only cloudwatch:PutMetricData action conditioned on cloudwatch:namespace=rebar/host, federating the existing GitHub OIDC provider without widening rebar-terraform-plan or Bedrock CI roles
A CloudWatch alarm on rebar/host:bridge_run_failures with period=3600 and threshold=1 must page on the second failed pass within an hour, distinguishing sustained outages from transient blips

Publishing 0 on success rather than relying on missing-data semantics makes the metric publisher itself continuously observable and transitions the alarm to OK state rather than INSUFFICIENT_DATA when healthy
